name: studyspace
description: StudySpace — a production-minded study collaboration platform.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @studyspace/shared && npm run dev --workspace @studyspace/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @studyspace/shared && npm run dev --workspace @studyspace/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @studyspace/shared && npm run build --workspace @studyspace/api && npm run build --workspace @studyspace/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @studyspace/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
